items.title: Using Headphones at a Voting Table
items.alt: A silver-haired man using a wheelchair wears headphones beside a blank tablet and a large button controller.
items.description: His royal-blue sweater contrasts with the pale wood surface and gray trousers. One hand rests near the blue controller button while the open space beneath the table accommodates the front of his chair.

items.title: Setting Up a Vote Direction Sign
items.alt: A woman in rust overalls kneels beside a small Vote arrow on a navy pole stand.
items.description: She steadies the upper fitting while working at the lower fastener beneath the sign. Her cream shirt, high bun and canvas shoes sit beside the wide round base of the freestanding pole.

items.title: Carrying a Folded Panel Case
items.alt: A silver-haired man in a green vest carries a pale hinged panel case by its top handle.
items.description: The closed rectangular case hangs beside his tan cargo trousers as he steps forward. Rolled sleeves, a blue shirt and a white mustache give the full-length worker a distinct appearance.

items.title: Setting Up a Polling Table
items.alt: Two Poll Worker volunteers unfold a pale rectangular table while steadying opposite ends.
items.description: The woman in an ochre jacket grips one corner as the man in a teal shirt supports the other. Their plain badges, bent table legs and dark cross-braces make the setup activity clear.

items.title: Preparing Sample Sheets
items.alt: A bespectacled man in a plum cardigan works over a Sample sheet at a wooden desk.
items.description: An open dark ink pad sits to one side of the cream paper, with a separate blank stack at the other. The seated man's focused expression and hands near the heading keep attention on the practice materials.

items.title: Sorting Election Paper Packets
items.alt: A silver-braided woman sorts clipped paper packets into three shallow wooden trays.
items.description: Red, blue and green clips distinguish the grouped papers across the narrow folding table. The woman's sage shirt and navy apron frame her hands as she places a packet into the left-hand tray.
